research_role: Stage 1 OpenAI CLIP held-out transfer design before any student training

encoder_decision.load_policy: OpenCLIP ViT-B-32-quickgelu, weights_only=True, strict=True, eval mode
encoder_decision.remoteclip_role: historical comparator only; not a forward-pipeline dependency

feature_space_rule.reason: Cross-encoder dot products and prototype reuse are invalid.

phase_1_proxy.purpose: low-cost no-training, OpenAI-CLIP-only held-out text matching diagnostic
phase_1_proxy.input_scope: existing LoveDA Train images and frozen candidate masks only; create OpenAI CLIP embeddings from pixels when an immutable input package is registered
phase_1_proxy.candidate_sampling: image-ID-based or all candidates; never select by VLM score, margin, prediction, pixel GT, or held-out correctness
phase_1_proxy.prototype_rule: any visual prototype is constructed in OpenAI CLIP space from seen classes only
phase_1_proxy.unseen_rule: held-out class has no prototype, calibration sample, threshold tuning, or prompt selection
phase_1_proxy.claim_limit: proxy weak-label transfer only; not true unseen accuracy or segmentation

leakage_controls.train_image_tags_origin: LoveDA Train pixel-mask presence simulation with minimum 16 pixels; inherited disclosure required

required_before_phase_1: an immutable all-candidate or image-ID-selected package containing the exact RGB crops and masks
a frozen row-key manifest, source hashes, and candidate-mask fingerprints
OpenAI CLIP checkpoint, tokenizer, preprocessing and prompt-token manifest
a pre-result analysis commit and protocol SHA-256
an OpenAI-CLIP-only feature cache or on-the-fly re-encoding; legacy RemoteCLIP feature files are rejected
